item.title: Staged publishing and new install-time controls for npm
item.description:
📝 Staged publishing is generally available Staged publishing is now generally available on npm. Recommended setup We recommend pairing staged publishing with trusted publishing (OIDC). --allow-directory: Controls installs from local directories.
🔗 Read more: https://github.blog/changelog/2026-05-22-staged-publishing-and-new-install-time-controls-for-npm/
